description: This Python source file implements a speech-to-text service using Fal's Wizper API, integrating with the Pipecat framework. It defines a service class `FalSTTService` that extends the `SegmentedSTTService`, handling audio transcription by interacting with Fal's API, managing language settings, and processing transcription results. The file includes helper functions for language code conversions and configurations for the service parameters.

classes.name: FalSTTService
classes.description: A speech-to-text service class that utilizes Fal's Wizper API for transcribing audio. It manages configuration parameters, initializes a Fal API client, handles language and model switching, and performs transcoding of audio bytes into transcriptions with support for asynchronous operation and tracing.
